single.rationale: American States Water is a stable regulated utility with predictable cash flows from water, electric, and military contracted services, showing consistent revenue growth (10.5% in FY2025) and solid margins (30.9% operating). However, the loss of full revenue decoupling mechanisms (WRAM/MCBA) introduces earnings volatility, capital intensity remains extremely high (capex exceeding operating cash flow), and the regulated utility model offers limited upside despite reasonable returns on equity (12.5%).
